REPORT z_i107_footprint.

DATA: gs_soh   TYPE zdemo_soh,
      gt_soh   TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF zdemo_soh,
      gv_tab   TYPE tabname,
      gv_subrc TYPE sy-subrc.

START-OF-SELECTION.

* plain Open SQL writes
  INSERT zdemo_soh FROM gs_soh.
  UPDATE zdemo_soh SET changedby = sy-uname WHERE salesorder = '1'.
  MODIFY zdemo_soh FROM TABLE gt_soh.
  DELETE FROM zdemo_soh WHERE salesorder = '2'.

* dynamic table name - the statically unresolvable case
  gv_tab = 'ZDEMO_SOH'.
  INSERT (gv_tab) FROM gs_soh.

* update task / background task
  CALL FUNCTION 'RFC_SYSTEM_INFO' IN UPDATE TASK.
  CALL FUNCTION 'RFC_SYSTEM_INFO' IN BACKGROUND TASK
    DESTINATION 'NONE'.

* transaction control
  COMMIT WORK AND WAIT.
  ROLLBACK WORK.
  CALL FUNCTION 'BAPI_TRANSACTION_COMMIT'
    EXPORTING
      wait = 'X'.
  CALL FUNCTION 'BAPI_TRANSACTION_ROLLBACK'.

* non Open SQL write paths
  EXPORT gs_soh TO DATABASE indx(zz) ID 'I107'.
  CALL TRANSACTION 'SE16' AND SKIP FIRST SCREEN.
  SUBMIT rsusr002 AND RETURN.

* a commented-out write must not be reported
* INSERT zdemo_soh_d FROM gs_soh.
  gv_subrc = sy-subrc. " INSERT zdemo_soh FROM gs_soh.
